messages.author: 4b890229d8cfaf55
messages.subject: Formatting plot, please help
parts:
Hi all, please consider following plot:

df1 <- data.frame(value=rnorm(2000), variable=rep(c("sample1", "sample2"), each=2))
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df1) + geom_density(aes(x=value, fill=variable), alpha=0.6)

In that following plot, I would like to do followings:
1. There is Black border on each of the density plot. I would like to stop showing any such border
2. In the legend pallet, there is diagonal black line for each of the color description. I want to stop showing that as well.
3. In the x-axis, instead of showing -3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3.. I would like to see -AA3, -AA2, -AA1, AA0, AA1, AA2, AA3 etc. I have seen there is some option called "formatter". However it seems to work only "%", "$" etc. Is there any option to put arbitrary notation like above?

Would be grateful if somebody helps me on how to achieve those formatting.

Thanks,

messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: Formatting plot, please help
parts:
Hi,

Try this,

my.format <- function(x, ...) {
signs = gsub("1|0", "", sign(x))
paste(signs, "AA", abs(x), sep="")
}

ggplot(df1) + geom_polygon(aes(x=value, fill=variable),
alpha=0.6,stat="density") +
scale_x_continuous(formatter = "my.format")

HTH,

baptiste

messages.subject: Re: Formatting plot, please help
parts:
HI:

To answer 1 & 2, another way is to set colour = 'transparent' as follows:

ggplot(df1) + geom_density(aes(x=value, fill=variable), colour = 'transparent', alpha=0.6)

HTH,
Dennis
